headlines.description: Lewis Koumas scored his first international goal to salvage Wales a 1-1 draw with World Cup-bound Ghana in Cardiff.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wales salvage draw with Ghana as Lewis Koumas opens account

headlines.description: Spain were left frustrated in their first World Cup warm-up match as they laboured to a 1-1 draw with Iraq at the Estadio de Riazor in La Coruña.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yamal-less Spain held by Iraq in WC sendoff

headlines.description: Manchester United forward Amad scored a late winner to give Ivory Coast a shock 2-1 victory over a much-changed France in their World Cup warmup match in Nantes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Amad nets late winner as Ivory Coast stun France

headlines.description: Portugal forward Rafael Leão was sent off for punching an opponent during a 2-0 win over Chile in a World Cup warmup on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leão sent off for punching opponent in Portugal win

headlines.description: Wales ended their season on a low note as Romania won their Bucharest friendly 2-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romania win to extend Wales' unwanted away record

headlines.description: The United States lost 2-1 to Germany at Soldier Field in Chicago on Saturday in its last match before the start of the FIFA World Cup, turning in another solid performance after Sunday's 3-2 win over Senegal.
headlines.shortLinkText: U.S. sharp in narrow WC sendoff loss to Germany

headlines.description: Nestory Irankunda has put on a show as the Socceroos claimed a 1-1 draw with Switzerland in their final warm-up game ahead of the World Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Socceroos draw with Swiss in final World Cup warm-up

headlines.description: Scotland will make their long-awaited return to the World Cup in confident mood following a convincing 4-0 friendly win over Bolivia in New Jersey.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scotland thrash Bolivia for perfect World Cup preparation

headlines.description: Harry Kane's header in first-half stoppage time was enough to give England a 1-0 win over New Zealand in the first of their two World Cup warm-up games in Florida on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane gives England win over NZ in WC warm-up

headlines.description: Endrick 's goal early in the second half gave Brazil a 2-1 win over Egypt in their final World Cup warm-up match.
headlines.shortLinkText: Endrick gives Brazil win over Egypt in final tuneup

headlines.description: Argentina beat Honduras 2-0 on Saturday in their second-to-last friendly before the FIFA World Cup begins on June 11.
headlines.shortLinkText: Messi left on bench as Argentina beat Honduras

headlines.description: Martin Ødegaard's second-half strike cancelled out an early Brahim Díaz goal as Norway drew 1-1 with Morocco in each team's final game before the World Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Martin Ødegaard salvages draw for Norway on eve of World Cup

headlines.description: Northern Ireland were undone by a superb Michael Olise hat-trick as France jetted off to the World Cup with a 3-1 friendly win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Michael Olise's hattrick sends France to World Cup with victory over Northern Ireland

headlines.description: Spain cruised to a 3-1 win over Peru on despite missing key players Lamine Yamal, Nico Williams, and Víctor Muñoz due to injuries.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spain finalize WC preparations with win over Peru
